name: Temple in the heart of the storms
description: The ancient temple housing the Omenpath, which Sarkhan's dragons tear apart.

timeline.summary: The storm falls silent and they find a massive ancient temple that Narset does not recognize from any records.
timeline.quote: There is a temple in the heart of the storms,

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, bound to the dragons by the ritual, resolves to destroy the temple that rivals his control.
timeline.quote: And the first thing he needed to do was destroy the temple.

pages_say.description: An ancient, massive temple at the foot of which Narset and Elspeth emerge; its architecture is unknown even to Ojutai's records.
The ancient temple housing the Omenpath, which Sarkhan's dragons tear apart.
